operational_counter_scope: Original parent, wrapper, workers, claims registry and HAIC environment. Kernel tests use only temporary synthetic processes and locks; synthetic SIGINT tests are not operational actions.
runtime_conditions_mandatory: Use the exact reviewed source SHA and /usr/bin/python3 public pidfd APIs; never signal the wrapper or a process group.
Hold the actual claims-directory exclusive flock and verify descriptor/current directory type and dev/inode identity.
Public /proc/locks must directly show one manager-owned FLOCK ADVISORY WRITE full-range lock and one exact-parent waiter linked by the same numeric lock ID and dev/inode.

Before the sole parent-pidfd SIGINT, two stored kernel snapshots must match parent identity, no live children, fully saved completed-prefix ledger, source pins and completed artifact hashes under the held lock.
No pending reset intent or unexecuted-slot artifact is allowed. An ambiguous pre-reset child must finish naturally with the lock released; missing raw data is never proof of zero reset.

Unreadable or absent public lock proof, identity/source drift, children, incomplete evidence, natural parent exit or unsupported interpreter must refuse without signaling and release held descriptors.

Only a paused receipt with unchanged ledger/artifacts, terminal KeyboardInterrupt report, no interrupted child and independently verified boundary proof can support later continuation. This review does not approve continuation or change any budget/gate/model.
metadata_discovery_review: This conventional run process proof is not an allocation descriptor and matches neither frozen run metadata names nor exposure/reset-intent markers. Actual protocols and reset-intent ledgers remain discovered and the KOI reset-ledger glob remains unchanged. No broad discovery exclusion was introduced.

tests.coverage: Linked owner/waiter identity, full range, exclusive FLOCK, inode, live-child and platform/read-permission refusals; no protected proof reads; two stored snapshots and receipt verification; natural active-child drain and ambiguous-child lock release; pre-signal source/identity/pending/artifact failures; descriptor cleanup with no signal; unsupported interpreter; portable mocked filesystem semantics and allocation discovery.

residual_risks: This is code and read-only pre-pause approval, not a claim that the running parent is already at a safe boundary. Every runtime gate must still pass.
The original deadline may expire or the parent may exit before a provable boundary; the manager must refuse rather than weakening proof or signaling a child.
Initial directory flock acquisition can block; inability to obtain or prove a boundary is not authorization for a different signal or permission escalation.
The preserved incomplete parent result must use guarded original finalization before any separately reviewed continuation metadata is published.
